root_cause.text: The BPF BTF destructor-kfunc type check was guarded by the obsolete `CONFIG_CFI_CLANG` Kconfig symbol instead of `CONFIG_CFI`, so on kernels with the renamed CFI option the CFI-based `btf_dtor_kfunc_t` validation code was compiled out and destructor kfunc type mismatches were not enforced.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CFI_CLANG))` to `if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CFI))` in `kernel/bpf/btf.c` inside `btf_check_dtor_kfuncs()`, and the commit message explicitly says the old name was renamed and “Using the wrong name results in the code getting compiled out,” causing “the CFI failures for btf_dtor_kfunc_t would still trigger.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Use the generic CFI configuration to validate destructor kfunc types under all CFI-enabled builds.
intent_record.what: In btf_check_dtor_kfuncs(), the preprocessor/configuration condition was changed from IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CFI_CLANG) to IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CFI) before performing the destructor kfunc type check.
intent_record.how: This broadens the extra destructor function type validation to apply when any CFI support is enabled, not only Clang CFI, so the code now enforces the btf_dtor_kfunc_t compatibility check under a wider set of builds.

grouping_result.intent: Use the generic CFI configuration to validate destructor kfunc types under all CFI-enabled builds.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it switches destructor-kfunc type validation to use the generic CFI config, fixing the bug where the check was incorrectly guarded by the obsolete CONFIG_CFI_CLANG symbol and compiled out on CONFIG_CFI builds.

candidates.rationale: This conditional gates the destructor kfunc type validation on the obsolete CONFIG_CFI_CLANG symbol. On kernels using the renamed CONFIG_CFI option, the validation block is compiled out, allowing destructor kfunc type mismatches to pass unchecked.

vuln_statements.explanation: This conditional incorrectly depends on the obsolete CONFIG_CFI_CLANG symbol. When kernels use the renamed CONFIG_CFI option, this block is not compiled, so the destructor-kfunc BTF type validation is skipped and mismatches are not enforced.
